environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS ALB with no WAF association. The ALB forwards all traffic directly to the container on port 3000. No rate limiting, no request inspection. Service is exposed via public ALB DNS endpoint. Container runs with default Node.js 18 runtime, no additional middleware filtering.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB, public-facing, no WAF attached
config.network: Public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443
